name: Karin
source:
[Spoiler]Accidental time traveler from the year 2053. Uses her mobile phone connected to the internet's future to tell fortunes.  

Granddaughter of [url=https://vndb.org/c149729/]Mizusawa Yoshihiko[/url], protagonist of the first game[/Spoiler]
